notes: Base/on-board I/O only; excludes the 4 modular expansion slots (optional cards: 16ch 3G/HD/SD-SDI, Dante 64ch AoIP, 64ch MADI, additional AES/analog, mic in, 8x8 GPIO) since their connectors vary by ordered configuration. Sources cross-checked: manufacturer product page (junger-audio.com), manufacturer/parent PDF brochure (jungeraudio.com "WOKS_prod_AIXpressor_A4_web.pdf"), and the Telos Alliance (parent company, current commercial site) product page, which had the most complete connector-level breakdown. The AES I/O and Analog In/Out are physically 25-pin D-Sub connectors wired to the AES59 standard, not literally XLR/AES3 or TRS jacks — "aes3" and "trs-6.35" were chosen as the closest available connector ids per instructions. AES I/O is switchable 8x8 or 4x12 channels; Analog In/Out are 8 channels each (Analog Out is a dedicated, separate DB-25, +4dBu balanced). MADI I/O ports are SFP cages that can alternatively be configured as Jünger's proprietary "tieLight" optical tie-line (up to 1024 ch/direction) instead of MADI. USB Client connector shape (B vs Micro-B vs C) and USB speed grade were not stated in any source, so USB ports are listed without a grade; USB-A used for the 2 host ports as the de-facto standard shape (not explicitly pictured in text). Sync In is a multi-standard input (Word Clock/AES11/Black Burst/Tri-Level), not a graded SDI signal, so left ungraded. Front-panel headphone jack included as physical audio I/O.
